rules.text: percentage of charges, but no gross charge to convert it to dollars
same amount for every procedure in this plan's list
absurd multiple of Medicare (below 0.1x or above 25x)
percentage rate but the gross charge is a placeholder
negotiated rate above the hospital's own gross charge
file's minimum is greater than its maximum
rate outside the file's own minimum-maximum range
more than 10x away from other Phoenix prices for this procedure and plan type
the item's gross charge is under a tenth of other Phoenix hospitals' gross charge for this procedure: likely a partial (component) line, not the full service
